cost: Grouping O(Vlog C+text bytes) plus chapter scan; layout_code O((S+T)log(S+T)+literal bytes), retains changed target layouts; text scans corpus keys O(V) plus rendered bytes. read_layout files/footnote repeated removal may cost quadratic heading bytes; no live filesystem parsing tested.
description: make sums selected verse words per chapter, greedily joins contiguous same-book chapters while sum<=max and emits oversized chapter alone. make_rt transports chapters into roundtrip::blocks::group. text renders chapter/layout/verse lines for target keys. layout_code charges source/target key symmetric differences and target layouts differing from available source, then reconstructs precisely target-key-restricted layouts using stored overrides or source defaults.

inverse: layout_code output never contains source-only keys or keys outside block. Changes inside a verse are not retained by read_layout's pending-before-verse model. make never combines different books or nonadjacent chapters.

Given source layouts, target keys and stored overrides, target layout is determined; returned layout alone admits multiple source layouts and key differences. Rendered block text loses original USFM markup/comments and formatting; many files produce same pending layout.
limitations: Source-derived effectful CLI/corpus paths only; no live model/annotator/training/filesystem/site run.
Finite synthetic helper checks and partial syntax; no universal proof or executable percent surrogate.
